registration.target: Strictly more than 70% profitable resolved trades, after costs, with >=1.5 realized payoff, positive expectancy and uncertainty/sample gates.
registration.scope: BTC-USDT unlevered Spot longs only. Research candidates, NOT the production Global report selector.
registration.priorExposure: This archive has already been used for production-rule diagnostics and supplied screenshot development. Chronological partitioning is NOT an untouched external validation. No candidate qualifies for a production profitability claim without new forward/independent evidence.
registration.selection: Select using train and validation only. Final outcomes cannot choose or retune any candidate. No qualifying candidate means no selection.
registration.antiCherryPicking: All 18 declared candidates across four frames and all splits are saved. No tuning after this run, no profitable subperiod extraction, no pooled win rate across overlapping frames.
